assessments.reasoning: The author, date and report number on the cover identify Snyder's September 9, 1990 NYU report 490. Its abstract and §1.1 identify SETL2 as a language and enumerate differences from SETL.

challenge.method: Compared the abstract's language-reference and implementation-guide distinction with §1.1's language features and its separate description of systems written in ANSI C.
challenge.results: Procedure nesting and block structure are presented as SETL2 design differences. The ANSI C material describes implementations of that design separately. The report defines the exact authority and terminology of the candidate.

limitations: This identity is scoped to Report 490. The same project name across earlier designs and later implementations does not establish edition or behavior equivalence.
